primary_evidence.description: Full 30,806-line start-command log of execution bb1c1a05-5394-4845-a88c-d4ddf9f2361c downloaded from the gist referenced in the issue body.
The 11 result events, their costs/turn counts, the 10 retry announcements and the final failure line.
Issue comments at capture time (empty array).
Replays all 11 captured result payloads through the pre-fix gateway predicate and the fixed classifier: 11/11 retryable before, 0/11 after.

external_sources.title: Anthropic API errors — 529 overloaded_error
external_sources.note: 529 is a capacity signal; Anthropic recommends retrying with exponential backoff and honouring retry-after.

external_sources.title: Exponential Backoff And Jitter (AWS Architecture Blog)
external_sources.note: Synchronised retries across clients amplify an outage; jitter spreads them.

external_sources.title: anthropics/claude-code#60577 — Transient 529 Overloaded API errors abort long-running tasks with no auto-recovery
external_sources.note: Confirms that upstream capacity errors can surface to CLI consumers and that callers are expected to own the retry policy.

external_sources.title: anthropics/claude-code#4146 — Anthropic API 529 Overloaded Error with Exponential Backoff Retry
p-retry (v8) — maxRetryTime option
external_sources.note: `maxRetryTime`: 'The maximum time (in milliseconds) that the retried operation is allowed to run. Measured with a monotonic clock.' Same semantics as our transient retry budget.

external_sources.title: cockatiel — retry/backoff/circuit-breaker policies
external_sources.note: ExponentialBackoff + retry policies; no wall-clock budget primitive, attempts-based.

external_sources.title: exponential-backoff (npm)
external_sources.note: numOfAttempts (default 10) and maxDelay (default Infinity); attempt-based only.

external_sources.title: node-retry
external_sources.note: Provides `maxRetryTime`, the wall-clock analogue p-retry re-exports.
